quotes.text: La fachada es de gran simplicidad, posee una amplia portada de piedra sin decoración situada en la esquina del edificio.
En la primera planta puede verse un balcón con guardapolvo de pizarra. En la segunda planta un bello mirador con arquerías sostenidas por columnas de mármol y un antepecho de tracería gótica calada.
quotes.page: Spanish Wikipedia, section 'Exterior'. The extractor leaves wikilink titles inline in this passage -- 'guardapolvo "Guardapolvo (arquitectura)")' and 'tracería gótica' -- and they have been removed without changing a word; the footnote markers rendered as stray '(' are likewise dropped.

measurements.name: storey_count
measurements.note: A READING AND A RISKY ONE. Spanish counts the ground floor as the planta baja and numbers upward from the first floor above it, so a building with a 'segunda planta' has three levels. The article never states a storey count; if its numbering is the English one instead, the answer is two. Recorded with the ambiguity rather than silently.
